reply.emotion: admiring and warm, praising someone who did the right thing
notes: In French, 'courageux' does not only mean brave in the face of danger; it is very commonly used to describe someone who works hard or puts a lot of effort into daily tasks.

senses.definition: Qui n'a pas peur du danger ou des difficultés.

examples.text: Il a été très courageux face au danger.
examples.translation: He was very brave in the face of danger.
examples.emotion: respectful and impressed by someone's strength

senses.definition: Qui travaille beaucoup et fait des efforts avec zèle.

examples.text: Elle est très courageuse dans son travail.
examples.translation: She is very hardworking in her job.
examples.emotion: appreciative and encouraging, noting a good work ethic
